rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent low-rise mass with a clear U-shaped/open-ended plan figure and a legible public void aligned to the access edge. That gives it decent gymnasium plausibility: a long-span hall can be read as the dominant body, with the carved center functioning as entry/court/threshold rather than a random subtraction. In plan and the two orthogonal elevations, the geometry holds together as one spatial rule, so it avoids the fragmented/overlapping failure modes. The main weakness is section specificity: the roof is comparatively flat and the mass does not strongly express span, structure, or daylight in the way a gymnasium ideally should. So program fit passes, but only moderately on section_program_fit and non_stair_silhouette because the silhouette is coherent yet somewhat bland and box-adjacent.
